t: Dine sika uneilat hassandal beyom hakkippurim
s: Dine sika uneilat hassandal beyom hakkippurim ubo y"a seipim: sika ketzad? Asur lasuk miqtzat gupo kekol gupo. Veim haya choleh apillu en bo sakkana, o sheyyesh lo chatatin berosho — sak kedarko veeno choshesh, shello aseru ella sika shel taanug. Abal belo shum choli, apillu eno mitkavven letaanug ella lehaabir et hazzuhama — asur. Veeno domeh lirchitza shekkol sheeno mitkavven letaanug muttar, lepi shehassika mitannegin bah yoter mittaanug rechitza, lepikak hechemiru bah yoter (veaseru ap besheeno mitkavven letaanug), ella im ken shehassika enah shel taanug kelal, kegon shessak lirpua:

Neilat hassandal ketzad? Asur linol minal shel or vesandal shel or apillu beraglo achat, veen chilluq ben beto lirshut harabbim — bekol maqom asur. Vaapillu sandal shel etz umechuppeh or — asur. Vaapillu mi shehu qittea — asur lo lilbosh qab shello (perush mi shenniqteu raglayv oseh lo depus kemin regel vechoqeq bo bet qibbul umanniach rosh shoqo betoko) im hu mechuppeh or. Umi sheepshar lo — tob lehachamir besandal shel etz apillu eno mechuppeh or:

Abal muttar linol sandal o minal shel gemi veshel qash veshel beged o shel shear minim, shehare gushe haaretz maggia leraglayv umargish shehu yachep, veod shello aseru ella minal vekol sheeno shel or eno niqra minal ella malbush:

Veken muttar likrok beged qasheh sebib raglayv. Umuttar latzet bo apillu lirshut harabbim, ap al pi shebbekol shabbetot hashshana asur latzet bo lirshut harabbim kevan sheeno derek malbush, mikkol maqom beyom hakkippurim kevan sheasur binilat hassandal vei epshar lo linol minal shel or — niqra zeh derek malbush leoto hayyom. Veyesh oserin latzet bo lirshut harabbim, ella im ken holek lidbar mitzva, o lishar dabar hekrechi lo bayyom hahu, vehu mepunnaq veen day lo bilbishat anpilaot mippene shehen asuyin mibbeged rak — az hittiru lo latzet lirshut harabbim bebeged qasheh vekaruk sebib raglayv. Vetob lehachamir kisbara zo. Abal latzet lirshut harabbim beanpilaot shel beged — muttar bekol inyan ledibre hakkol, kevan shellobeshan derek lebisha. Vehu haddin shemmuttar latzet bekol min minal sheeno shel or apillu lirshut harabbim. Muttar laamod beyom hakkippurim al gabbe karim ukesatot apillu hen shel or, sheen zeh hanaat derek neila, velo aseru ella keshehu manil beraglayv. Mikkol maqom hammachamir bekarim ukesatot shel or — tabo alayv beraka. Bammeh debarim amurim? Shello bishat tepillat shemoneh esreh, abal beshaa shemmitpallel tepillat shemoneh esreh — asur laamod al gabbe karim ukesatot apillu enan shel or, mishshum shennireh kemitgaeh im yaamod al karim bishat tepilla. Abal muttar laamod al shear debarim chutz min karim ukesatot apillu beshaa shemmitpallel tepillat shemoneh esreh im eno gaboah shelosha tepachim min haaretz, kemo shennitbaer besiman tz':

Chayya kol sheloshim yom achar lidtah — mutteret linol apillu beyom hakkippurim, mippene shehatztzinna qasha lah. Veken choleh apillu en bo sakkana ella shehatztzinna qasha lo, veken mi sheyyesh lo makka beraglayv — muttarim linol:

Veken im yaredu geshamim verotzeh lelek mibbet hakkeneset lebeto o lehepek, vehu adam mepunnaq umitztaer belikluk raglayv beme geshamim — muttar lo linol, ukesheyyaggia lebeto o lebet hakkeneset yachletzem. Abal mi sheeno mepunnaq — asur. Abal im yesh sham repesh vatit — muttar lekol adam linol, lepi shehakkol chashubin mepunnaqin leinyan zeh (veyesh omerim deap betit varepesh en hetter ella lemi sheyyadua shehu mepunnaq, abal en kol adam yakol lomar mepunnaq ani. Abal hamminhag kassebara harishona). Abal lo kemo shennohagin rabbim mehamon am sheholekim barechob beminalim ap sheen sham repesh vatit ukeshebbain lebet hakkeneset hem holekim gam ken beminalim raq behaggio limqomo choletz, veellu bachasheka yithalleku uposheim niqreu im enan shomeim leqol morehem:

Haholek bemaqom shemmetzuyim aqrabbim o shear debarim hannoshekin — muttar lo linol apillu minal shel or, vaapillu eno holek lidbar mitzva ella letayyel — muttar linol kede shello yishshekennu aqrab vekayyotze bo:

Kesheholek mibbeto lebet hakkeneset beminalim — lo yelek bahen bebet hakkeneset. Veken lo yannichem bebet hakkeneset begaluy, lepi shellikluk sheal gabbe hamminalim hu zilzul lebet hakkeneset beyom qadosh kazeh shechayyabim lekabbedo biksut neqiyya ubekol debar tohora, ella yannichem bemaqom mutzna bebet hakkeneset shello yiru, o yishlechem lebeto im epshar lo:

Hamhallek badderek, ap al pi shebbetisha beab muttar binilat hassandal — beyom hakkippurim asur, lepi sheiqqar issur neilat hassandal beyom hakkippurim hu min hattora kemo shennitbaer besiman try"a ayyen sham, lepikak hechemiru bo yoter mibbetisha beab:
Veken mittaam zeh haholek ben hannokrim vechoshesh shello yaligu alayv, ap al pi shebbetisha beab muttar linol — beyom hakkippurim asur:
Kol maqom shemmuttar linol — tob sheyyachlip minal shel semol beyamin veshel yamin lismol:
